title: CCA Fleet Analytics & Predictive Maintenance
summary: Fleet analytics application combining vehicle diagnostics, repairs, and vehicle-use data to explore patterns and early-detection strategies for CCA-related repairs.
contribution: Developed the analytical backend, REST API, data-visualization interface, alert-rule simulation and optimization, and a machine-learning module for training and evaluating predictive classifiers.
evidence: Code includes analytical views and REST endpoints for data queries and simulations.
Alert simulation supports DTC codes, thresholds, time windows, and configurable combination logic.
Optimization compares the trade-off between identifying repairs and limiting false alarms.
Exploratory classifiers include Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and logistic regression.
No validated model-performance, breakdown-reduction, or cost-saving claims are available.
privacyNotes: Do not publish real Volvo data, screenshots, or internal links.
Any public demo must use synthetic data.
No verified public project link is currently available.
highlights: Alert-rule simulator: configure DTC codes, thresholds, time windows and combination logic, then classify alerts by their timing relative to repairs.
Rule optimization to compare early detection against false alarms.
Exploratory classifiers (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, logistic regression) for repair prediction.
Built on internal fleet data, so no data, screenshots or results are published here.

title: MatchKeeper | London Goalkeeper Marketplace
status: Free-beta application deployed to staging and in release preparation
summary: Full-stack marketplace connecting amateur football teams and players who need a goalkeeper with freelance goalkeepers available for matches in London.
contribution: Sole creator and owner. Led the product concept, UX/UI design, technical architecture, and end-to-end development.
evidence: Player and goalkeeper dashboards, match creation and discovery, applications, and team selection.
Manually reviewed profiles, in-app chat, maps, calendars, check-in, reviews, match history, and admin moderation.
Supplied-account checks verified both dashboards and the player calendar on staging; these checks do not establish adoption or business impact.
Stripe Connect paid bookings are implemented and sandbox-tested but inactive; no real-money or production-payment verification is available.
privacyNotes: Do not claim that MatchKeeper processes live payments.
Do not claim broader adoption or business impact without evidence.
The production domain currently serves an earlier validation landing page.
highlights: Role-specific dashboards for players and goalkeepers.
Match creation, nearby discovery, applications and team selection.
In-app chat, maps, calendars, match check-in, reviews and admin moderation.
Paid bookings through Stripe Connect are built and sandbox-tested but switched off; the beta is free.
